title: On CLI, display simple information on PrestaShopException
issue_title: On CLI, display simple information on PrestaShopException
issue_body:
### Describe the bug
On composer install / update, if your shop is supposed to be installed but the MySQL server unavailable, a PrestaShopException will be thrown. Even if we are in CLI, data in HTML will be displayed on your terminal, and your RAM will be saturated. In my case, I have to reboot my computer every time it happens... This PR add the Cli case and only display the exception class, file & line, a finally a small stack trace.

### Steps to reproduce
Make your MySQL server unreachable by turning it off or modifying the credentials in your file `app/config/parameters.php`. Then try a `composer update`

title: Introduced a consistent method to get route name if Hooks dispatched in modern pages
issue_title: Introduced a consistent method to get route name if Hooks dispatched in modern pages
issue_body:
### Describe the bug
Sounds like https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/pull/8470 is incomplete for Product page because we still call the legacy controller with Symfony, so we need to make `getRoute()` function available for legacy Admin controllers too. Also, sometimes "even" in Product page the `getRoute()` equals to 'AdminProducts' instead of the real route because the legacy controller is still called. So I advice you to access to the route value directly from $hook parameters in Symfony context until the migration of Product page will be totally done.

### Steps to reproduce
Install the `ps_test` module (https://github.com/mickaelandrieu/ps_test) and switch on `xml-serializer` branch. On `1.7.3.x` branch, the product catalog page is broken, with this pull request the rendering is OK.

title: Be able to identify a modern page in modules
issue_title: Be able to identify a modern page in modules
issue_body:
### Describe the bug
There is no way to distinct a specific page using Controller name with new controllers, for instance you can't apply a hook on product catalog page and not in product page itself.

### Steps to reproduce
You need to create a minimal module that hook on "displayAdminAfterHeader". Using `$this->context->controller->php_self` you'll have the same value for "Products" and "Product page (this is a normal and logic behavior). If you want to hook only on "Product page" you'll need the new `$this->context->controller->getRoute()` and get the route name from the Symfony debug toolbar.
